confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Dublin price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, since July hotel and hostel rates in Dublin vary widely with events and demand. The FX value was taken from search-result snippets of the RBA statistics page, not from an opened page or the F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other high-cost Western European capitals with strong summer tourism (for example Amsterdam, Edinburgh and Copenhagen) for restaurants and bars, with an upward adjustment for Dublin's pub and hotel pricing.
